trial_court: Family Court, Patna, Cr.Misc. No.24671 of 2008
case_name: Sanjay Gupta & Ors vs The State Of Bihar & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sanjay Gupta, Prem Chand Agarwal, Uma Agarwal, Shekhar Gupta, Smt. Lata Gupta — husband, father, mother, son, wife
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Bihar, Smt. Manjusha Gupta — government, wife

facts_of_case: Manjusha Gupta married Sanjay Gupta in 1996. They lived together till October, 2004. However, relationships deteriorated and they agreed to divorce by mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: In cases where parties have lived apart for a long time, it is proper to grant a decree of divorce.
legal_principles.held: In view of the fact that both the parties have lived apart for fourteen years and have not been able to reconcile to live with each other, it is proper that the decree of divorce should be granted to them so that they can have a brighter future.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to settle their disputes through a one-time settlement.
legal_principles.held: The parties agreed to the following terms: ... Sanjay Gupta would pay a sum of Rs. 5 lacs as one time settlement to Manjusha Gupta.

outcome.final_order: Decree of divorce granted to the parties so that they can have a brighter future.
